stories.title: Chhath Puja runs from Friday 13 to Monday 16 November; anti-foam spraying seen at Kalindi Kunj ahead of the festival
stories.body: Delhi's four-day Chhath Puja festival begins on Friday 13 November, with the main day on Sunday 15 November and the festival ending on Monday 16 November, according to an ANI report of Friday 6 November. A PTI report of Tuesday 10 November says the Lieutenant Governor has declared Monday 16 November a holiday in government offices, autonomous bodies and public sector undertakings. Outlook India photographs from Tuesday 3 November show a worker spraying an anti-foaming solution from a boat on the Yamuna near Kalindi Kunj; photos from Friday 30 October show foam near Kalindi Kunj and Okhla Barrage. Officials have said traffic police will coordinate parking, diversions and closures near ghats.
stories.check: No 2026 Delhi Traffic Police advisory naming Kalindi Kunj was found, and no source says which ghats will operate there. The foam photos are from 30 October to 3 November, not from this week. Confirm the ghat arrangements and any diversions on Delhi Traffic Police channels before publishing.
